intro: Hey hey! It's the Paws and Claws Club!
chorus: Jump in, splash out, one, two, three,
Rainy day fun for you and me!
verses: Red and round for a lion fella!
Spin it, spin it, one, two, three,
Rory stays dry as dry can be!
And a raincoat with a hood that's cute!
Tip toe, tip toe, one, two, three,
Splash! Now he's in a muddy muddle!
Pebble loves the rain the most,
He slides along from coast to coast!
bridge: Look up high, the rain has gone,
The sun comes out to shine upon,
A rainbow arching in the sky,
Wave to the clouds and say goodbye!
outro: What a splashy day! Bye bye, friends!
